title: State the race and year of race in which Michael Schumacher had his fastest
question:
State the race and year of race in which Michael Schumacher had his fastest lap.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: fastest lap refers to min(milliseconds); Alex Yoong refers to the full name of the driver; Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
    r.XCL_069 AS race,
    r.XCL_066 AS year_of_race
FROM
    lapTimes lt
JOIN
    drivers d ON lt.XCL_044 = d.XCL_034
JOIN
    races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
WHERE
    d.XCL_038 = 'Michael'
    AND d.XCL_039 = 'Schumacher'
ORDER BY
    lt.XCL_047 ASC
LIMIT 1
